name: pulse-chat
description: Responsive production-quality React chat application UI

paragraphs: A polished, responsive chat application frontend inspired by the familiar interaction patterns of WhatsApp and Facebook Messenger. Pulse Chat is built as a production-minded React single-page application with reusable components, protected routing, persistent client state, realistic mock data, validation, loading/error/empty states, and a service layer ready to connect to a backend.

This repository currently delivers the complete frontend milestone. Authentication, messaging, profile updates, and preferences are simulated locally; no production backend or realtime transport is connected yet.
features: Login, sign-up, and forgot-password pages with protected and auth-only routes.
Field-level and submit-time validation with accessible error messages.
Email format checks and strong-password rules: 8+ characters, uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol.
Password and confirmation show/hide controls, password-strength feedback, terms validation, and loading states.
Success and error feedback through Sonner toast notifications.
